clarifications: The first player places a marker on any start mark, then players continue clockwise until everyone has placed a marker; markers are placed before any tiles are played.
Play continues clockwise around the board.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rules PDF linked from the Calliope Games product page (https://calliopegames.com/shop/tsuro-the-game-of-the-path/) at https://www.dropbox.com/s/sth0b0vx06jbqej/Tsuro_Rules.pdf, SHA-256 06b0b76f79b4e71726bb91364a6d296396830a959177b5374107c728d99772ed. The one-page sheet has no text layer, so it was rendered and read visually. Playing the Game: the oldest player takes the first turn; the first player places a marker on a start mark, continuing clockwise until each player has placed a marker, before any tiles are played. Draw Tiles: once all players have three tiles or the pile is empty, play continues clockwise. Credits: original game design Tom McMurchie, copyright 2020 Compound Fun, Inc. (Calliope Games). The 2-8 player path-tile game matches BGG 16992. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rules give no tie-break for players of the same age.
